_comment: kn_brain community feed (services/brain/community.c, doc/backend.md 'Community feed'). Copy to config/community.json (or set brain.community.feed); the brain rereads it when it changes. news: the What's New window and the hub's News tab; events / polls: the menu's Community & Events popup. Dates are UTC ISO 8601. Events past ended_at (else start_date + duration_hours) and polls past ends_at are not served.
